latin: Intellectus possibiles qui illuminantur tantum plures sunt; agentes participati illuminantes et illuminati plures quoque sunt; agens illuminans tantum unus.
translation: The possible intellects, which are only illuminated, are many; the participated agent intellects, which both illuminate and are illuminated, are also many; the agent that only illuminates is one alone.
